answer: In this design, remote attestation binds each agent identity to an enclave’s MRENCLAVE, the cryptographic measurement of its loaded code, and verifies that measurement against a trusted platform. A copied VM cannot mint a distinct hardware-backed attestation, so creating additional identities requires access to additional eligible silicon rather than merely duplicating software. The tundra of possible Sybil nodes is narrowed, while the attestation bridge links each agent to a verifiable hardware root, not a river of anonymous virtual instances.
